notes.title: KILL ALL ENEMIES is based on Twin-Stick Survivors and just released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

A while ago development of Twin-Stick Survivors changed its direction away from a tower/base defense to "you just walk around yourself and kill all the enemies". However a lot of the core ideas persist like fighting thousands of enemies and becoming really powerful. So you might be interested in this new version of the game as well.

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3555460/extras/Gif1.gif[/img]

There are also abilities that let you snipe enemies from a save distance and slow time to kill enemies before they can even react. You can check out the trailer and the new store page!

[previewyoutube=PERkQ3oDJo8;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3555460/KILL_ALL_ENEMIES/

notes.title: Demo | Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
The demo for Twin-Stick Survivors is part of Steam Next Fest and [b]available now[/b]! You can try and beat the first map by surviving for 20 minutes. You'll have to expand your base to get more upgrades and deploy turrets to defend your territory. Any feedback you might have is highly appreciated :)

The demo will remain available [b]until the 28th of October[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3079660/TwinStick_Survivors/
